title: Insider Threat Case Record Schema
description: Corrected v2.1 validation schema for intentional insider threat case-study coding. Fixes v2 JSON syntax issues, aligns the template with required fields, corrects attack_step and attack_step_goal as arrays, and removes uniqueItems from actor-characteristic arrays so ordered multi-actor coding can repeat values where necessary.

case_id.description: Unique case identifier. Use the format CS-001, CS-002, etc. The template placeholder CS-000 should be replaced during coding.

source.description: Source of the case data, such as report, court document, media source, academic case, or internal dataset.

reference.description: Unique case reference, citation, URL, document name, or dataset reference.

case_summary.description: Short factual summary of the case.

include_for_stage_2.description: Whether the case proceeds to Stage 2 analysis.

screening_note.description: Analyst screening notes, including reasons for inclusion, exclusion, and uncertainty.

precipitating_event.description: Triggering event or catalyst associated with the insider behaviour. Use 'unknown' if no trigger is stated or defensibly inferable.

actors.description: Actor-specific information. Add one object for each actor involved in the incident.

actor_id.description: Identifier for the actor (e.g., actor_1, actor_2).

state_of_relationship.description: Current relationship between the enterprise and the actor.

psychological_state.description: Actor's psychological or emotional state, coded only when supported by evidence.

personality_characteristics.description: Actor personality characteristics, coded conservatively and only when directly stated or strongly supported.

attitude_towards_work.description: Actor's feelings, perceptions, or behavioural orientation toward work.

motivation_to_attack.description: Reason or motive for the attack, coded only when supported by evidence.

skill_set.description: Description of the actor's relevant skills or capabilities that enable the attack. Use 'unknown' if not stated.

opportunity.description: Actor's opportunity to initiate or conduct the attack.

historical_behaviour.description: Relevant historical behaviour before the incident.

observed_physical_behaviour.description: Observed physical-world behaviour relevant to the case.

enum: access_and_authentication (Activities related to logging into systems and accessing organisational resources. (ex:Logins, failed logins, after-hours access, remote access, privilege use))
data_and_file_management (How users interact with organisational data and files.(ex:File creation, modification, deletion, copying, downloading, uploading, printing))
communication_activities (Use of communication channels within and outside the organisation.(Email, messaging, file sharing, external communications))
system_and_network_behaviour (Interaction with software, operating systems, organisational applications and network.(Running programs, executing scripts, installing software, administrative actions))
privilege_and_security_behaviour (Actions involving security controls or privileged access.(Policy violations, privilege misuse, security control evasion, suspicious actions))

attack.description: Whether the harmful activity was intentional, unintentional, other, or unknown.

attack_objective.description: Primary objective or outcome associated with the attack.

attack_step.description: Specific activities undertaken to conduct the attack. Use technique names/IDs which are mentioned bellow

enum: AS01:preparation/planning (Activities undertaken to prepare for the intended insider incident).
AS02:target_identification (Identifying valuable information, systems, accounts, people, or organisational assets).
AS03:information_gathering / Discovery (Obtaining information about systems, data, processes, vulnerabilities, or security arrangements).
AS04:access/access_acquisition (Obtaining or using the access necessary to perform the intended activity).
AS05:privilege/permission_Abuse (Misusing legitimate privileges or obtaining additional permissions to reach restricted resources.
AS06:collection/acquisition (Gathering the information, credentials, files, or other assets relevant to the attack objective).
AS07:execution/action (Performing the substantive malicious or unauthorised activity against the organisation, system, or data).
AS08:data_transfer/exfiltration (Moving information or assets to an unauthorised destination or recipient.)
AS09:manipulation/modification (Altering, corrupting, deleting, or otherwise changing organisational data or systems).
AS10:sabotage/disruption (Deliberately interfering with systems, services, or operations.)
AS11:concealment/evasion (Actions intended to reduce the likelihood of detection or attribution.)
AS12:persistence/continued_access (Maintaining the ability to access or affect systems after the initial activity.)

attack_step_goal.description: Specific outcome/goal after the the attack steps take place

enum: G01:confidentiality_loss	(Unauthorised disclosure, exposure, copying, transfer, or access to information that should remain restricted to authorised individuals or systems)

G02:integrity_loss(Unauthorised alteration, manipulation, corruption, deletion, falsification, or destruction of information, systems, software, or processes that compromises their accuracy, completeness, or trustworthiness)
G03:availability_loss (Preventing or reducing authorised users' ability to access information, systems, services, networks, or resources when required)
G04:financial_loss (Direct or indirect financial harm resulting from the insider activity, including theft, fraud, unauthorised transactions, financial manipulation, or monetary losses)

G05:reputational_damage	(Harm to the organisation's reputation, credibility, trust, public image, or relationships with customers, partners, regulators, or other stakeholders as a consequence of the insider activity)

G06:privacy_loss	(Unauthorised exposure, acquisition, disclosure, or misuse of personal, private, or personally identifiable information belonging to employees, customers, clients, or other individuals)

G07:operational_disruption (Interference with normal organisational activities, business processes, services, or workflows that reduces the organisation's ability to conduct its operations effectively)

asset.description: Targeted organisational asset, data, system, process, or service.

vulnerability.description: Organisational or control vulnerabilities that enabled or worsened the incident.
